input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in full: six months of transition assistance on request (priced at the expiring Order Form rates, which is better for us than "then-current rates"), return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, and no withholding for fee disputes. Deletion occurs only after we confirm successful return, with written officer certification and a narrow legal-retention carve-out that stays protected. Sections 10 and 15 are consistent and contain no immediate-deletion or data-hostage language. No redline needed.
